heroTagline: FORGING THE FUTURE OF ENTREPRENEURSHIP & ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
heroSubtext: Dayananda Sagar University's premier innovation ecosystem uniting engineers, designers, researchers, and student founders in artificial intelligence.

landingContent.aboutText: To cultivate a vibrant community at DSU, fostering innovation in AI and entrepreneurship through collaborative projects.
landingContent.pillarsSubtext: Our approach to innovation is built on three core strategies.

pillars.title: Innovation
pillars.description: We encourage groundbreaking ideas and provide GPU compute, lab access, and development toolkits for members to explore the frontiers of AI.

pillars.title: Collaboration
pillars.description: We believe in the power of diverse minds working together, fostering a supportive cross-disciplinary environment for peer learning and growth.

pillars.title: Impact
pillars.description: Our projects aim to solve real-world problems, making a tangible difference across healthcare, robotics, education, and venture incubation.

landingContent.projectsSubtext: Showcasing our creations. Explore our innovative projects, where theory meets practice in the exciting fields of AI and entrepreneurship.

projects.title: Agentic Workflow Accelerator
projects.description: Autonomous multi-agent orchestration framework for research synthesis, developed by student engineers in the AI technical wing.

projects.title: Autonomous Edge Vision
projects.description: Embedded computer vision system optimizing real-time obstacle navigation for autonomous robotics platforms.

projects.title: Responsible AI Benchmarking
projects.description: Comprehensive evaluation framework for auditing bias, safety, and hallucination rates in generative language models.

landingContent.approachSubtext: We foster a dynamic environment where students can transform their ideas into impactful AI and entrepreneurial ventures.

approach.title: Ideation & Problem Discovery
approach.description: We guide members from initial concepts to well-defined project proposals, encouraging creative problem-solving and patent exploration.

approach.title: Prototyping & GPU Compute
approach.description: Providing high-performance compute clusters, research lab access, and technical mentorship for rapid iteration.

approach.title: Venture Incubation & Launch
approach.description: Supporting student founders through legal incorporation, pitch deck polish, and demo day showcases to seed investors.

approach.title: Community & Knowledge Transfer
approach.description: Building an enduring alumni and mentor network, hosting weekly paper reading groups, and sharing open-source code.
